messages:
Alex: Quick sync request — we need to agree a telemetry contract for degradation signals that oncall + console can rely on. timeout / 5xx / OOM / degraded-mode (fallback) counts are the core.
Marta: +1. what's the minimal shape we need? labels, cardinality constraints, and docs would be great. :eyes:
Raj: Minimal fields from runtime: metric name, type label (timeout/5xx/oom/fallback), route, model, region, pool. Keep cardinality bounded: no user_id or request_id.
Sam: For dashboards we also need outcome vs request count so we can report rates (errors / requests). So runtime should emit requests_total{route,model,region,pool}.
Priya: Agree. Also export a fallback_type label for degraded-mode so we can separate model-variant vs policy-fallbacks.
Alex: Proposed metric names (proto):
```
# counters (monotonic)
runtime_errors_total{type="timeout"|"5xx"|"oom", route="/v1/generate", model="gpt-3h", region="us-west1", pool="dedicated"}
fallbacks_total{fallback_type="model_variant"|"policy", route=..., model=..., region=...}
requests_total{route=..., model=..., region=..., pool=...}
```
We should also export last_error_sample{route,model,region} as a label set for short-circuit debug in console (low volume gauge).
Marta: That looks fine. Who owns the Prometheus/metrics schema docs? ConsolePM: I'll own the doc page and the dashboard templates. Need examples of alert rules and SLOs.
Raj: On cardinality: model should be model_family not full commit hash. pool is ok. region must be coarse (us-west1) not AZ.
Sam: For dashboards we want a computed "degradation_score" to de-dup noise and drive a single oncall panel. Proposal:
```
# example derived metric (pseudo)
degradation_score(route,region) = 0.6 * timeout_rate + 0.3 * five_xx_rate + 0.1 * fallback_rate
# where *_rate = increase(metric[5m]) / increase(requests_total[5m])
```
This gives weight to timeouts mainly but keeps visibility of fallbacks.
Priya: Can we add an 'oom_kill' subtype so we can distinguish OOM vs soft-fallback?
Alex: Yes — runtime will emit runtime_errors_total with subtype label when appropriate.
infra-bot: deployment:metrics-agent v2.3 rolling to runtime clusters today 02:15 UTC — will add runtime_errors_total and requests_total. :white_check_mark:
Marta: Timeline OK. After that ConsolePM can wire a dashboard and a compact oncall view (single tile with breakdown by route/model).
ConsolePM: Plan for dashboard: overview panel (degradation_score heatmap), lane panels for timeout_rate, 5xx_rate, fallback_rate, OOM trend, and a table of recent unique error samples. Also add a "scope" filter (route/model/region).
Raj: For alerts, prefer per-route alerting with suppression rules if model=experimental. Example rule draft:
```
alert: HighDegradationByRoute
expr: (sum by(route,region) (increase(runtime_errors_total{type=~"timeout|5xx"}[5m]))
      / sum by(route,region) (increase(requests_total[5m]))) > 0.02
for: 10m
labels: {severity="page"}
annotations: {runbook_url="https://redwood/runbooks/degradation"}
```
Sam: Also add a fallback-only alarm to catch traffic silently hitting degraded-mode:
```
expr: increase(fallbacks_total[route!="/health"][5m]) > 50
```
Priya: Need to ensure the runtime doesn't emit exploded label combos when model/tag changes rapidly. We'll add a blacklist for dynamic tags.
Alex: Action items: 1) Raj/infra to finalize metric names and push schema to the metrics repo by EOD. 2) infra-bot will roll the agent (already in progress). 3) ConsolePM to draft dashboard templates + alert drafts. 4) Oncall to validate SLI/SLO math in a staging dashboard.
Marta: Can we add a small tracing hook: error_sample_id that points to trace id (only when sampling) so we can click through from dashboard? Low volume.
Raj: We'll add sampled_error_id label with low cardinality sampling.
ConsolePM: I'll schedule a 30m follow-up tomorrow to walk through dashboards with oncall and runtime owners.
Alex: Thanks everyone. If infra-bot finishes the roll I'll test the staging dashboard and ping here with screenshots. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: metrics-agent v2.3 deployed to 4 clusters (us-west1/us-east1/eu-west1/ap-south1).
